MONETARY POLICY DECISIONS OF THE CBC BOARD MEETING (June 28, 2001)
MONETARY POLICY DECISIONS OF THE CBC BOARD MEETING (June 28, 2001)
In line with the deliberations made at the Board meeting on June 28, the future directions for monetary policy of the Central Bank of China, Taipei, shall be the following:

1.The Bank decided to cut the discount rate, the rate on accommodations with collateral and the rate on accommodations without collateral each by 25 basis points, from 3.75%, 4.125% and 6.0% to 3.50%, 3.875% and 5.75%, respectively, effective from June 29.
